name: Royal Court Hotel
beachAccess: On the clifftops at White Rocks; no distance stated
confirmedFeatures: Free WiFi, licensed restaurant and grill room, open all year
overview: A clifftop hotel at White Rocks, just east of Portrush, looking over the Royal Portrush links towards Donegal, the Giant's Causeway and the Scottish isles. It has 13 bedrooms and five suites, free WiFi and a licensed restaurant and grill room serving food daily. It is open all year and the listing names watersports visitors among its guests.
surfTripFit: The closest hotel to Whiterocks, so you can check the banks from the clifftop and be in the water quickly, with dinner on site afterwards.
